exposure: Implementation of an immediate postpartum long-acting reversible contraception (LARC) program
outcome: LARC (intrauterine device [IUD] or etonogestrel implant) use postpartum
IUD expulsion rate of IUDs placed immediately postpartum
Rates of women without contraception plans at delivery
Number of women using medroxyprogesterone acetate
cohort: The study participants were pregnant patients with cardiac disease managed by a Comprehensive Pregnancy & Heart Program.
finding: LARC use tripled from 11% to 35% in pregnant patients with heart disease after the implementation of an immediate postpartum LARC Program.
